# `irs527_transmissions`

**IRS Section 527 bulk archive transmission metadata**

Header and footer transmission metadata from the IRS PolOrgsFullData.zip Section 527 bulk export, comparing footer counts with observed data records.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Complete single-snapshot header and footer summary for the captured IRS Section 527 PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `irs527_transmissions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transmission_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal H-record transmission date string before parsing. |
| `transmission_time_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal H-record transmission time string. |
| `file_id_modifier` | `VARCHAR` | Literal H-record file identifier modifier (such as A, B, C, D, or F). |
| `transmission_date` | `DATE` | Parsed H-record transmission date; null when blank or unparsed. |
| `transmission_date_status` | `VARCHAR` | Parsed, blank, or unparsed status for transmission_date. |
| `footer_transmission_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal F-record footer transmission date string. |
| `footer_transmission_time_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal F-record footer transmission time string. |
| `footer_record_count` | `BIGINT` | Data record count stated in the F footer record. |
| `observed_data_records` | `BIGINT` | Count of valid parsed data records written across the seven record-type tables. |
| `malformed_row_count` | `BIGINT` | Count of publisher-truncated data rows quarantined to source evidence (observed_data_records + malformed_row_count equals footer_record_count). |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official IRS Section 527 fullData download URL. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC timestamp when PolOrgsFullData.zip was captured. |
